text: Oatly Group AB's largest shareholder is Nativus Company Limited, which beneficially owned 284,253,953 ordinary shares, or 44.6% of the outstanding ordinary shares, as of March 11, 2026.
short: Nativus Company Limited owns 44.6% of Oatly.

source.name: Oatly Group AB — Annual Report on Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 (SEC EDGAR), Item 7.A Major Shareholders
source.quote: Nativus Company Limited (1) 284,253,953 44.6 % Platin S.a.r.l. (2) 63,984,219 10.1 % Blackstone Funds (3) 59,877,869 9.3 %
source.note: Filed with the SEC on 2026-03-13; table of 5%-or-greater shareholders as of March 11, 2026 (Platin S.a.r.l. 10.1%, Blackstone Funds 9.3% and Hillhouse Investment Management Ltd. 7.0% follow in the same table).

additionalSources.name: Mannheimer Swartling — Oatly announces financing commitments of USD 425 million
additionalSources.quote: co-owner of the joint venture company Nativus, Oatly’s largest shareholder
additionalSources.note: Swiss-Swedish law firm's assignment note describing Verlinvest S.A. as co-owner of Nativus, 'Oatly's largest shareholder'.
